about: Texts with addresses of attachments, each file with a marker name: the rows of the tables of what GitHub links cut, with a suffix or as something else, what must not break, and a search over each character after and before an address in the text, a destination, between < and >, in a src and in a row of a table, over brackets, code, tags, references and what cuts an address; with what GitHub's renderer links of each as the href of an a or the src of an img, and the words of the page outside a link that hold an address (gh api -X POST markdown with mode gfm, 2026-11-22). An address counts only where the page links exactly it or shows it as text; where it is hard to tell, the reading takes out an address that GitHub links as it is written: those are listed.
